description: Reads one project right now, as Marsell's chat reads it at the start of every turn: the app's index (the chat's tools call it input.app: every place in the menu with its pages, every agent with where it stands in one line, what is connected and counted, how many cards wait for the owner, and what only the owner can press) and the brief of the business's situation (input.situation: the stage, the plan's week, the numbers, and in more the parts situation_read opens whole). Open a place with place_open, an agent with agent_open, every agent with agents_read, the cards with waiting_read. A quick daily look is get_overview.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: get_app
title: Get the app's index
